title: Current reconstruction and adaptive ship path following in Yingongzhou: companion simulation data
description: Eight manuscript tables, reconstructed-current exports, preserved computational sources, selected historical experiment outputs and parsed CSVs, and nineteen newly repeated full-route records: four steady cases and fifteen representative derivative, command-margin, current-prior, and noise cases. All rerun RMS and maximum errors match historical values at reported precision. Historical derivative summaries include all 32 paired G2/G4 samples. Missing time series for remaining derivative seeds, phases, refinement, and complete sweeps are identified explicitly. No observational current dataset is included.
repository_status: GitHub companion-data repository provisioned; retained data and archive limitations are documented in README.md. No DOI assigned.
